description: This file defines the ProtocolServices class which implements ILogConsistencyProtocolServices. It provides distributed protocol functionalities for log view adaptors in Orleans, including error handling, exception catching, and logging, with grain-specific context.

classes.name: ProtocolServices
classes.description: Implements distributed protocol services for log consistency in Orleans, providing error handling, exception logging, and deep copying functionalities.

methods.name: ProtocolServices
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ProtocolServices with grain context, logger factory, deep copier, and silo details.

methods.name: GrainId
methods.description: Property returning the GrainId from the grain context.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs a deep copy of the provided value using the deepCopier.

methods.name: ProtocolError
methods.description: Logs a protocol error and optionally throws an OrleansException based on the throwexception flag.

methods.name: CaughtException
methods.description: Logs an exception caught at a specific location.

methods.name: CaughtUserCodeException
methods.description: Logs a warning when a user code exception is caught.

methods.name: Log
methods.description: Logs a message at the specified log level with formatted message and arguments.
